Vendored third-party browser assets for the anvil admin UI.

Doctrine (AU9): anvil ships as a single binary that runs offline. No
CDN, no auto-update, no phone-home. Every browser asset is committed
here with a SHA-256 checksum receipt.

To upgrade: download the new file, replace it here, update its SHA-256
line in this file, and bump the version in the comment. CI will fail
if the on-disk SHA-256 does not match the receipt (see
test/anvil/web/vendored_assets_test.clj).
